lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits. A central vertical column of three large, prominent blobs is visible, followed by subsequent vertical columns of smaller blobs extending towards the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present across the mid-flank, with the circular high-luminance blobs centered within these bands to form grid-like anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible first dorsal fin contains a scattered distribution of several small, high-luminance blobs across its surface, though clarity is limited by image resolution.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin shows a high density of small, high-intensity spots. The gill slits are clearly visible as five high-contrast, vertical dark lines.
